description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Migrate the project to Java 25 to leverage the latest LTS features, performance improvements, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK to version 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all source and target compiler settings are updated to Java 25. Resolve any compilation errors or deprecation warnings introduced by the Java 25 upgrade. If the project uses Spring Boot or Spring Framework versions that are incompatible with Java 25, confirm with the user before upgrading those frameworks.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgraded Java version from 21 to 25 in pom.xml and Dockerfile. Spring Boot 4.0.1 is already compatible with Java 25. Build succeeded with JDK 25.0.3. No CVEs found in dependencies.
